name: idempotent records aggregate by engine and mission
input: two touching intervals and a duplicate event
test:
ledger = EngineFlightLedger()
assert ledger.record('a', 'eng-1', 'm-1', 0, 5) is True
assert ledger.record('a', 'eng-1', 'm-1', 0, 5) is False
assert ledger.record('b', 'eng-1', 'm-1', 5, 9) is True
assert ledger.record('c', 'eng-2', 'm-1', 2, 6) is True
assert ledger.engine_flight_time('eng-1') == 9
assert ledger.engine_flight_time('eng-1', 3, 7) == 4
assert ledger.mission_flight_time('m-1') == 13

name: rejects overlapping intervals and invalid queries
input: overlap on one engine and malformed window
